tools.name: returnlogic_list_rmas
tools.description: List return merchandise authorizations (RMAs, i.e. customer returns) with workflow status, return type (refund, exchange, warranty, giftcard), items, customer email and order. Filter by status, type, reason, email, order, date range, flags or 'requires action'. GET /v1/rmas.

tools.name: returnlogic_count_rmas
tools.description: Count RMAs matching the same filters as returnlogic_list_rmas (for example how many returns are Requested or require action). GET /v1/rmas/count.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma
tools.description: One RMA by id: status, comments, order link, shopper and warehouse addresses, items with quantities, reasons, approval/receipt state, labels and timeline. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma_item_type_history
tools.description: The history of return-type changes (e.g. refund changed to exchange) of one RMA item. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaItemId}/returntypehistory.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma_metafields
tools.description: Custom metafields (key, value, reportable) stored on an RMA. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/metafields.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma_item_metafields
tools.description: Custom metafields stored on one item of an RMA. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/items/{rlRmaItemId}/metafields.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_orders
tools.description: List orders known to ReturnLogic (synced from the store) with items, customer, amounts and statuses. Filter by order number/name, email, date range or financial status. GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: returnlogic_count_orders
tools.description: Count orders matching the same filters as returnlogic_list_orders. GET /v1/orders/count.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_order
tools.description: One order by ReturnLogic order id (rlOrderId) with its line items, addresses and statuses. GET /v1/orders/{rlOrderId}.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, or find one by email or external customer id. GET /v1/customers/list.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by ReturnLogic customer id (rlCustomerId). GET /v1/customers/{rlCustomerId}.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_products
tools.description: List products with their variants (SKUs, barcodes). Filter by SKU, category id, status or external (store) product ids. GET /v1/products.

tools.name: returnlogic_count_products
tools.description: Count products matching a SKU, category or status filter. GET /v1/products/count.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_product
tools.description: One product by ReturnLogic product id (rlProductId) with its variants. GET /v1/products/{rlProductId}.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_product_categories
tools.description: List product categories (used for return rules). Search by name or external category ids. GET /v1/productCategories.

tools.name: returnlogic_flag_rma
tools.description: WRITE: flag an RMA so the team can filter for it, with an optional comment. A flag cannot be removed afterwards. It sends nothing to the customer. POST /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/flag.

tools.name: returnlogic_mark_rma_items_received
tools.description: WRITE: record the warehouse receipt of one or more RMA items (received true/false, optional disposition code that must already exist in ReturnLogic). When every item is received the RMA becomes Received, and if the store uses Automated Processing for Received, the RMA may then be processed automatic

tools.name: returnlogic_add_rma_metafields
tools.description: WRITE: add custom metafields (key/value notes or reference numbers) to an RMA. A key can be used once per RMA. 'reportable' true makes the field visible on RMAs and reports; false keeps it API-only. Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/metafields.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "returnlogic_list_rmas" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: returnlogic_list_rmas, returnlogic_get_rma, returnlogic_list_orders, returnlogic_list_customers · Private data: returnlogic_mark_rma_items_received · Public sink: returnlogic_list_rmas, returnlogic_list_orders, returnlogic_list_customers, returnlogic_flag_rma, returnlogic_add_rma_metafields.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: returnlogic_list_rmas, returnlogic_get_rma, returnlogic_list_orders, returnlogic_list_customers · Private data: returnlogic_mark_rma_items_received · Public sink: returnlogic_list_rmas, returnlogic_list_orders, returnlogic_list_customers, returnlogic_flag_rma, returnlogic_add_rma_metafields

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
